the-lab.title: what is an ai agent, in plain words
the-lab.description: an agent is a robot that plans, acts and checks its own work toward a goal. here's a one-page brief you can copy.

the-lab.title: the context window, why ai forgets
the-lab.description: the context window is everything an ai can see right now. old lines fall out the top. here's how to work with that.

the-lab.title: how ai thinks, one step at a time
the-lab.description: ai models work through problems in steps. ask for the steps and you get better answers. here's a prompt to try.

the-lab.title: tokens, how ai reads in pieces
the-lab.description: models read text in small pieces called tokens, not whole words. that's why limits and costs are counted this way.

the-lab.title: prompts are specs, not wishes
the-lab.description: a prompt works best when it's a clear spec. here's a simple spec template that gets good output on the first try.

the-lab.title: memory, what ai keeps between chats
the-lab.description: ai doesn't remember you by default. memory is notes it files and pulls back when needed. here's how to build your own.

the-lab.title: tools, how ai does things, not just says things
the-lab.description: tools let an ai search, open files and run code. here's how to decide what to give it and what to keep locked.

the-lab.title: hallucination, when ai makes things up
the-lab.description: ai can state something false with total confidence. here's why it happens and a prompt that cuts it down.

the-lab.title: temperature, how ai picks between safe and surprising
the-lab.description: temperature controls how adventurous a model's word picks are. low for steady and exact, high for fresh ideas. try both.

the-studio.title: how i automated my content pipeline
the-studio.description: how i film on my phone and let ai agents edit, check and schedule every video. the method, plus five templates you can copy today.
